changelog.body:
# 🌘 InstaEclipse v0.8.2

> ⚠️ **Two builds now.** **InstaEclipse** is for the new Xposed API (**Vector 2.2+** with root, **LSPatch 1.0+** without root). **InstaEclipse Legacy** (`0.8.2-L`) is for the classic API (LSPosed and other frameworks that don't support the new one yet). Both have the same features. If v0.8.1 didn't load on your phone (several Redmi / Xiaomi users), try Legacy. Install over your existing version, no reinstall required.

Profile tools, a profile spoofer and analyzer, confirmations before liking and following, one tap data backup and a batch of your requests. Tested on Instagram **451.0.0.20.80**.

---

## ✨ New Features

### 👤 Profiles
- **feat(profile):** Profile ⋮ menu - Copy username, Copy bio and Download all posts
- **feat(download):** Download a whole profile - all posts, or just the newest 12, 30, 50, 100 or any number, newest first
- **feat(profile):** Profile analyzer - add a profile to your watchlist, and each analysis shows who it newly followed or unfollowed, and who followed or stopped following it, with a change log per profile
- **feat(profile):** Profile spoofer (only on your phone, nothing is sent) - your username, name, bio, picture, posts / followers / following counts and a verified badge, with a live preview editor. The bottom tab picture follows while you're on your profile, and Edit profile keeps your real details

### 📝 Posts
- **feat(posts):** Edit counts on your own posts (only on your phone) - likes, comments, reposts and shares from the post's ⋮ menu, applied at once

### ❤️ Likes and Follows
- **feat(likes):** Ask before liking - the heart waits for your OK, and stays empty if you cancel
- **feat(follow):** Ask before following - feed, suggestions, collaborator sheets and the profile Follow button; Cancel puts the button back

### 💬 Messages
- **feat(dm):** Hide suggested accounts in Messages (#282)
- **feat(dm):** Hide Instants, in Distraction Free

### 📖 Stories
- **feat(stories):** A real color picker for the story ring - Instagram's colors, one color or a gradient of 2 to 4 colors, with presets, sliders and hex

### 🧭 Navigation
- **feat(nav):** Back on Home leaves Instagram (#272)

### ⬇️ Downloads
- **feat(download):** Quieter, quicker download dialog - no progress popup, one tap when there's one choice, current slide / all / choose for carousels (#287, #288, #289)
- **feat(download):** Redesigned Save video frame, with true colors and one-frame steps
- **feat(download):** When the InstaEclipse app can't be reached (sleeping app, autostart off), downloads still save instead of failing: to your folder when it's inside Download, otherwise to Download

### 💾 Backup
- **feat(backup):** Back up data - deleted messages, analyzed profiles, followers history, hidden chats and chat names, and edited post counts in one file, restored in one tap after reinstalling Instagram

### 📱 Companion App
- **feat(sync):** Switches flipped in the app apply in Instagram right away, and both menus stay in step
- **feat(setup):** The app asks to run unrestricted when a download folder is set, asks to choose the folder again if its access was lost, and asks for storage on Android 9
- **refactor(toast):** Every toast uses the InstaEclipse style

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **fix(likes):** Ask before liking sends the like after you press Like on LSPatch, and the heart no longer fills before you answer on Instagram 451
- **fix(download):** No "couldn't reach the app" warning when the file was saved to your folder anyway
- **fix(dm):** Unsent messages and Hide this chat are back in the chat menu, titled with the chat's name; Back from the unsent list returns to the chat menu
- **fix(comments):** Reels comments open to full height for Load all, so every comment loads
- **fix(instants):** The Gallery button works when the camera opens from the Instants stack
- **fix(compat):** Safe class walking on Android 12 and older (fixed crashes on some Redmi phones)
- **fix(core):** JIT guard in every hook callback
- **fix(profile):** The profile menu rows scroll with Instagram's list and only show on a profile that is on screen
- **fix(profile):** The spoofed verified badge only shows on your own profile

---

## ⚡ Performance

- **perf(startup):** DexKit lookups are cached per Instagram version, so startup takes about 1.5 s instead of 9.5 s (#285)
- **chore(log):** Quieter logs - lookups that are expected to miss on this Instagram version no longer show as errors

---

## 🌍 Translations

- Every new string translated into all 19 languages

---

## 💙 Thank You

Thank you to everyone who requested features, tested the builds and sent logs, especially the Redmi, Galaxy S24 Ultra and S25 Ultra users who helped track down the loading, like and download issues.

---

## ⚙️ Other

- Two APKs: InstaEclipse (new Xposed API) and InstaEclipse Legacy `0.8.2-L` (classic API)
- README lists the new features and explains which build to install
- Tested on Instagram **451.0.0.20.80**

## What's Changed
* InstaEclipse 0.8.2 by @ReSo7200 in https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/pull/PR_NUMBER


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/compare/v0.8.1...v0.8.2

# 🌘 InstaEclipse v0.8.1

> ⚠️ **Update your framework first.** InstaEclipse now runs on the new Xposed API: it needs **Vector 2.2+** (root) or **LSPatch 1.0+** (no root). Then install over your existing v0.8.0, no reinstall required.

The new Xposed API, HDR video and a batch of your requests, tested on Instagram **451.0.0.20.80** and **452.0.0.43.64**.

---

## ✨ New Features

### ⚙️ New Xposed API
- **feat(xposed):** libxposed API 102 support - InstaEclipse loads through the new API on Vector 2.2+ and LSPatch 1.0+ (#264)
- **feat(xposed):** Settings reach Instagram through the framework's remote preferences
- **build:** One APK for root and no root

### 🎞️ Quality and HDR
- **refactor(menu):** New Quality section with force reel quality, high resolution images, max upload quality and Spoof device
- **feat(devops):** Spoof device - Instagram sees a Pixel 11 Pro XL or Galaxy S26 Ultra, which unlocks HDR video
- **feat(downloads):** One Download quality choice: Standard, or Best (HDR included) with an optional cap from 2160p to 480p - thanks to [zellbruv](https://github.com/zellbruv)
- **feat(downloads):** Save a single video frame as a full-resolution PNG - thanks to [zellbruv](https://github.com/zellbruv)

### 💬 Messages
- **feat(chat):** Unsend multiple messages - check your messages right in the chat and unsend them all at once (#245)
- **feat(dm):** Ask before calling - the audio and video call buttons ask first (#277)
- **feat(dm):** Download stickers and GIFs in their original format, named after the sender
- **feat(dm):** Per-account hidden chats and an option to keep received unsent messages in the chat - thanks to [zellbruv](https://github.com/zellbruv)

### 📖 Stories
- **feat(stories):** Story tray size and ring color - make the tray smaller to fit more stories, and pick a preset, your own color or a two-color gradient (#283)

### ✨ Feed
- **feat(feed):** Rounded corners on feed photos and videos (#276)
- **feat(feed):** Ask before refreshing - an accidental pull down no longer loses your place (#278)
- **feat(feed):** Choose the date format for exact dates, from presets or your own pattern (#265)

### 🎬 Reels
- **feat(reels):** Hold the left side of a reel for slow motion, the right side for 2x

### 👤 Profiles
- **feat(profile):** Full-size profile picture viewer
- **feat(followers):** Followers history - who unfollowed you and who followed you since your last check
- **feat(profile):** Fancy fonts for the bio

### 🔒 Privacy
- **feat(ghost):** Don't save searches - profiles, tags and places you open from Search stay out of Recent, on the phone and on Instagram's server (#280)

### 🧭 Menu
- **refactor(menu):** Features moved to where they act: Ghost Mode keeps what others would notice about you, Distraction Free gets Meta AI, onboarding prompts and Plus upsells, App and Account gets link options. Same layout in Instagram and the companion app
- **chore(settings):** Save Instants moved to the Downloader section

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **fix(feed):** Hide liked posts and Hide suggestions work again on Instagram 451
- **fix(core):** The Android 13 JIT crash guard now covers Vector's hooks too
- **fix(ipc):** Settings sync, downloads and logs work with LSPatch-patched Instagram
- **fix(download):** Videos save at the best quality available, and a Dolby Vision track is no longer counted twice
- **fix(dm):** Saving a DM photo or video goes through the downloader: named after the sender, in their folder, at the best quality
- **fix(saved):** The collection lock no longer pushes the back arrow and title aside while a collection loads or closes
- **fix(toast):** The load toast lists every enabled feature again
- **fix(unsent):** A chat's unsent messages no longer show in other chats
- **fix(chat-export):** The export is named after the username
- **fix(comments):** Load all keeps paging while the search dialog is open
- **fix(discover-people):** The Discover people carousel is hidden on profiles too
- **fix(share-sheet):** "Send to new group chat" is hidden when several chats are selected
- **fix(instants):** The gallery button only shows on the Instants camera
- **fix(links):** Also strip four-letter tracking parameters - thanks to [lyubomyr-shaydariv](https://github.com/lyubomyr-shaydariv)
- **fix:** Safer resource loading and argument handling, plus ProGuard rules - thanks to [s1ddhants1](https://github.com/s1ddhants1)

---

## 🔒 Security

This section is by [zellbruv](https://github.com/zellbruv).

- **feat(ipc):** Companion operations are authenticated, with bounded private IPC
- **feat(sync):** Signed settings sync between Instagram and the companion app
- **fix(logs):** Hardened log persistence and host bindings

---

## 🌍 Translations

- Every new string translated into all 19 languages

---

## 💙 Thank You

A big thank you to [zellbruv](https://github.com/zellbruv) for the downloader, chat controls and security work, to [s1ddhants1](https://github.com/s1ddhants1) for the Xposed compatibility fixes, to [lyubomyr-shaydariv](https://github.com/lyubomyr-shaydariv) for the link fix, to [oozanturkmen](https://github.com/oozanturkmen) for the feature requests, and to everyone who tested and reported bugs.

---

## ⚙️ Other

- **chore(license):** InstaEclipse is now licensed under GPL-3.0
- README follows the new menu layout and setup
- Tested on Instagram **451.0.0.20.80** and **452.0.0.43.64**

## What's Changed
* fix(links): also strip any four-letter tracking params by @lyubomyr-shaydariv in https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/pull/262
* Contribute/remaining fork improvements by @zellbruv in https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/pull/270

# 🌘 InstaEclipse v0.8.0

> ✅ **No reinstall required.** You can update over your existing v0.7.x installation.

The biggest update so far, tested on Instagram **451.0.0.20.80**.

---

## ✨ New Features

### 📖 Stories
- **feat(stories):** Story Info - exact posted, expiry and edit times, the song, location, hashtags, reshared from, original post or reel, posting app, alt text, size, countdowns, questions, Add Yours (exact joined count and top people), paid partnership and collaborators. Tap any line to copy it
- **feat(stories):** Music links - open a story's song in Spotify, YouTube Music or Apple Music
- **feat(stories):** Poll, slider and quiz results drawn as bars, with your own answer marked and the correct quiz answer in green
- **feat(stories):** Copy the links from link stickers, or pick from a list when there are several
- **feat(stories):** Hold a mention to open that profile
- **feat(stories):** Search your story viewers
- **feat(stories):** Download a whole highlight from its long press menu
- **feat(ghost):** Mark a single story as seen on purpose, from the story menu

### 💬 Messages
- **feat(dm):** One InstaEclipse button in every chat header: unsent messages, export, jump to the first message, read receipts for just that chat, and hide or unhide the chat
- **feat(dm):** Edit history - see every earlier version of an edited message
- **feat(dm):** Chat export to a readable HTML page with replies, reactions, edit history and optional media
- **feat(dm):** Jump to the first message of a chat
- **feat(dm):** Voice message downloads, named by sender
- **feat(chats):** Translate with app - send a message to your translator app (Google Translate, DeepL and others) from its long press menu
- **feat(ghost):** Read receipts for specific chats while Hide DM seen stays on for everyone else
- **feat(unsent):** Unsent messages are logged per chat and named after the chat

### 🎬 Reels and video
- **feat(media):** Playback speed from 0.5x to 3x for reels, stories, highlights and feed videos
- **feat(media):** Always show the reel seek bar
- **feat(extras):** Reels auto scroll and Reels scroll lock - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)

### 📥 Downloads and media
- **feat(media):** Media info - resolution, file size, codec, qualities, and the song with Spotify, YouTube Music and Apple Music links
- **feat(media):** "Open with" another app from Media info - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(download):** Audio only - save just the audio of a video or reel, including a post's music
- **feat(download):** Copy image straight to the clipboard
- **feat(download):** "Download with InstaEclipse" share target for post and reel links
- **feat(download):** One carousel menu with item choice, numbered items and audio
- **feat(media):** Always upload at the highest quality
- **feat(instants):** Upload an Instant from your gallery

### ✨ Feed, likes and comments
- **feat(feed):** Following only feed - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(feed):** Hide posts you already liked, hide community notes, always show full captions
- **feat(misc):** Exact dates instead of "2h ago"
- **feat(misc):** Undo a like within a few seconds
- **feat(misc):** Disable double tap to like now also covers comments and DMs - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(comments):** Comment search with "Load all", reply tree and HTML export, plus downloads for GIF and image comments
- **feat(text):** Translate captions and comments, with or without hashtags
- **feat(captions):** Copy captions without hashtags - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(ui):** Hide Instagram Plus upsells

### 👤 Profiles
- **feat(ui):** "Follows you" label on every profile
- **feat(follows):** Export followers and following to CSV
- **feat(profile):** Saved button on your own profile
- **feat(saved):** Lock Saved collections with your passcode

### 🧭 Navigation and extras
- **feat(nav):** Hide bottom tabs and reorder them
- **feat(navigation):** Choose the tab Instagram opens on - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(extras):** New Extras section: disable swipe to camera, airplane mode, high resolution images, unlimited accounts, hide onboarding prompts, notification fix, hide only the story tray - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(ui):** Hide the Threads button on profiles, the Blend button in chats, the Notes tray and "Create group" on the share sheet
- **feat(links):** Open links in your own browser
- **feat(links):** Custom share domain - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)
- **feat(location):** Location spoofing now covers every location path, with place names and recent places - thanks to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol)

### 🎨 Look and feel
- **feat(menu):** The menu is regrouped by what things do (Feed, Navigation, Reels, Stories, Ghost Mode, Messages, Downloads, Likes and Comments, Profiles and more), the same in Instagram and in the companion app
- **feat(theme):** A light and a dark version of every theme, following your phone
- **feat(ui):** InstaEclipse's own menus, toggles and dialogs follow your theme's accent color, with bordered cards
- **feat(menus):** Proper icons for InstaEclipse rows in the post and reel menus
- **feat(ui):** One modern dialog and toast design everywhere
- **feat(app):** Companion app home dashboard with status, quick actions and pinned shortcuts, feature search, an animated About page and an expandable FAQ

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **fix(ig451):** Restore the hooks Instagram broke on 448 to 452, every feature found at runtime with DexKit
- **fix(crash):** Guard every hook callback against the ART JIT crash on Android 13
- **fix(speed):** Playback speed opens over stories and posts opened from a profile, really applies to them, and the story resumes after you pick a speed
- **fix(stories):** Story menu features work on your own story, with no "Mark as seen" there - thanks to [izadiegizabal](https://github.com/izadiegizabal)
- **fix(theme):** Theme every Instagram screen including Compose ones like the DM inbox, and keep light themes readable
- **fix(sync):** Settings changed in Instagram reach the companion app and the other way around, even when one was not running
- **fix(app):** Settings that were only in the in-Instagram menu are now in the companion app too, with hints for the few that can only be set on one side
- **fix(unsent):** Unsent messages are named after the chat even if you never opened it
- **fix(saved):** The collection lock button no longer stays after leaving a collection
- **fix(links):** Strip only the tracking parts from shared links, including the `psln` share id
- **fix(downloads):** No unrelated video for photo posts, GIFs saved as .gif, correct image URLs on Instagram 452
- **fix(distraction):** Distraction Free applies live and blocks swiping into Reels when Reels are off
- **fix(ui):** Status bar handled through an AppBarLayout - thanks to [HackZy01](https://github.com/HackZy01)

---

## 🔒 Security and performance

All of this section is by [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol).

- **fix(security):** Only the companion app can send settings into Instagram
- **fix(security):** PBKDF2 lock passcode with a lockout after wrong tries
- **fix(security):** Validate download requests to the exported download service
- **fix(privacy):** Drop QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES and unused storage permissions
- **fix(storage):** Crash safe writes for settings and small JSON stores
- **perf(startup):** Hooks load in Instagram's main process only, with a cold DexKit start in the background
- **perf(downloads):** Bounded download pool with timeouts
- **perf(views,logging):** Cached resource lookups and no disk I/O under the log lock
- **fix(update-check):** Proper version comparison and a hardened update check
- **fix(dev-config):** Validate imported configs and write them atomically

---

## 🌍 Translations

- New language: **Vietnamese** - thanks to [ThinhNguyen2005](https://github.com/ThinhNguyen2005)
- Turkish updated - thanks to [MrRaita](https://github.com/MrRaita)
- Polish updated - thanks to [HackZy01](https://github.com/HackZy01)
- Every new string translated into all 18 languages

---

## 💙 Thank You

A big thank you to [b4lol](https://github.com/b4lol) for the extras, security and performance work in this release, to [izadiegizabal](https://github.com/izadiegizabal) for own story downloads, and to everyone who tested, reported bugs and translated InstaEclipse.

---

## ⚙️ Other

- README rewritten for 0.8
- Tested on Instagram **451.0.0.20.80**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ReSo7200/InstaEclipse/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0

# 🌘 InstaEclipse v0.6.0

> ✅ **No reinstall required.** You can update over your existing v0.5.x installation.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **InstaEclipse is being succeeded by the [Purrfect](https://t.me/purrfect_tg) project.** Development here will stay active until Purrfect reaches a stable release — follow the Telegram channel for progress updates.

---

## ✨ New Features

- **feat(theme):** Custom Theme — recolor Instagram with built-in presets or a full custom color picker (background, surface, text, accent, icons, and more), applied live without restarting Instagram
- **feat(location):** GPS Location Spoofing with an interactive map picker — search a place or drop a pin to fake your reported location
- **feat(quality):** Force Reels Quality — pin Reels playback to a fixed resolution (360p–1080p, Auto, or Max Available) instead of Instagram's adaptive bitrate
- **feat(logs):** In-app Log Viewer — see hook activity from both Instagram and the companion app without adb
- **feat(ui):** Full icon-based redesign of the in-app dialog and companion app, replacing the old emoji-driven menus

- **feat(clean-feed):** Hide Threads Suggestions split out into its own toggle, independent of the general feed-suggestions toggle
- **feat(devops):** Restore to Default Config option for the Developer Config
- **feat(misc):** Spoof Last Seen (freeze) — freeze your "last active" status instead of updating it live

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **fix(feed,misc):** Stop Photo Zoom and Video Autoplay hooks from disrupting taps app-wide — both were intercepting core Android touch/render APIs unconditionally, causing intermittent dropped taps on story-advance and DM media opens
- **fix(mentions):** Resolve the story mention pipeline via stable field/string anchors instead of guessed signatures
- **fix(post-download):** Restore and harden post/reel download after an Instagram menu refactor

- **fix(ghost-typing):** Restore the typing indicator block after a signature change

- **fix(devops):** Update the MobileConfig ID for Instagram's employee-gate refactor
- **fix(clean-feed):** Mark the hide-suggestions status as soon as the hook installs
- **fix(ads):** Refactor tracking-link stripping to catch tracking parameters anywhere in the URL, not just when they're the first query parameter

---

## 🌍 Translations

- Full emoji cleanup across every supported locale's menu and section labels, replaced by the new icon-based UI
- Complete Polish translation added and brought fully up to date with 0.6.0's new strings

---

## ⚙️ Other

- CI now builds on every push/PR with concurrency control (stale runs get cancelled automatically) and a pre-build test step

## What's Changed

# 🌘 InstaEclipse v0.5.0 — The Biggest Update Yet                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  > ⚠️ **Fresh install required.** Uninstall your previous version before installing v0.5.0.
                                          
  ---
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  ## ✨ This isn't just an update. It's a rebuild.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  v0.5.0 ships a completely overhauled companion app, a brand new downloader, new ghost features, global language support, and a wave of long-requested additions. If you've been waiting for a reason to reinstall — this is it.

  ---

  ## 📥 All-New Downloader

  Save anything. Posts, carousels, reels, stories, feed videos, and full-resolution profile pictures — all from within Instagram, no third-party app needed.

  - Long-press any profile to save the full-res picture
  - Choose a custom download folder - From the InstaEclipse Module UI
  - Optional username subfolders to keep everything organized

  ---

  ## 👻 New Ghost Features

  Three powerful additions to Ghost Mode:

  - **Unlimited View-Once Replays** — Replay view-once media as many times as you want
  - **Permanent View Once Media** — View-once media stays open and replayable like regular media (This might cause issues)
  - **Keep Disappearing Messages** — Stop ephemeral messages from deleting themselves
  - **Allow Screenshots in DMs** — Re-enable screenshot capability in restricted chats

  ---

  ## 🎨 Brand New App UI

  The InstaEclipse companion app has been completely redesigned from scratch. Material You, sectioned menus, a staging system that lets you queue multiple changes and apply them all at once — it feels like a different app.

  ---

  ## ⚙️ Developer Options

  - **Remove Build Expired Popup** — Keep using older Instagram builds without the forced update nag

  ---

  ## 🛠️Miscellaneous

  - **Copy Comment** — Copy any comment text with a single tap
  - **View Story Mentions** — See all @mentions in a story at once
  - **Disable Discover People** — Remove the "People you may know" section from your feed

  ---

  ## 💾 Backup & Restore

  Export all your InstaEclipse settings to a file and restore them anytime — perfect for switching devices or reinstalling without losing your setup.

  ---

  ## 🌍 InstaEclipse Now Speaks 14 Languages

  Arabic · Azerbaijani · German · Spanish · French · Greek · Hebrew · Indonesian · Portuguese · Russian · Swedish · Turkish · Traditional Chinese · Simplified Chinese

  Every string, every dialog, every toast — fully translated. Massive thanks to every contributor who made this happen.

  ---

  ## ⚡ DexKit Startup Cache

  DexKit scans are now cached per Instagram version. Same version = zero rescan on next launch. Faster startup, every time.

  ---

  ## 🐛 Bug Fixes

  - Ghost mode toggles now correctly persist their state across sessions
  - Various stability and compatibility improvements

  ---

  ## 📄 Project

  - README fully rewritten with collapsible feature sections, full root + no-root install guides, and a live contributor grid
  - `DISCLAIMER.md` added
  - GitHub issue templates — structured bug reports and feature requests with pre-flight checklists

  ---

  ### 💙 Thank you for every star, report, and translation. v0.5.0 is for you.

## What's Changed

readme:
InstaEclipse

Instagram, the way you want it.
A Vector (Xposed) module for privacy, downloads, a cleaner feed, smarter stories and DMs, and your own look. Everything is a switch inside Instagram.

Features • Compatibility • Installation • Using it • FAQ • Contributors

---

## What is it InstaEclipse is a module for [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector), the Xposed framework formerly known as LSPosed (rooted phones), and [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) (no root). Long press the Explore (search) tab inside Instagram and the InstaEclipse menu slides up. Flip what you want, and most things apply right away. It comes with a companion app too. That is where you see whether the module is running, read its logs, back up your settings, edit themes, and get help. Under the hood, InstaEclipse uses [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) to find what it needs inside Instagram every time Instagram updates, instead of relying on names that change with each build. So when Instagram ships a new version, most features keep working without waiting for a module update. > InstaEclipse is a personal, educational project. It is not affiliated with Meta or Instagram. See the [Disclaimer](DISCLAIMER.md). --- ## Features Everything here is a switch in the menu. Tap a section to open it.
